source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Topic 5.4 (PDF 146, printed 143).

blocks.text: Data visualization ka matlab hai data ko visual format (tasveer ki shakal) mein dikhana, jaise graphs ya charts. Is se data ke patterns, trends (cheezein kis taraf ja rahi hain) aur insights (kaam ki baatein) jaldi samajh aati hain.

blocks.prompt: Data visualization ka kaunsa faida NAHI hai: trends aur patterns pehchanna, baat saaf tareeqe se samjhana, data ko zyada complex banana, ya bare datasets ki summary? (MCQ 7)
blocks.explanation: (c) data ko zyada complex banana; visualization to data samajhna aasan banata hai.

items: Visualization numbers ko tasveeron (charts) mein badalta hai jo patterns aur trends dikhati hain.
